answer: A newcomer violet enters the garden only when a sponsor violet with 20 attested epochs vouches for it, locking cedar that doubles with each violet that sponsor has already admitted: 1, 2, 4, 8 cedar. If any admitted violet cheats, the garden burns every cedar bond up its sponsor chain. A farm must therefore grow as a tree, each generation waiting 20 epochs to mature, so a thousand clones from one seed need about 200 epochs or exponentially rising bonds, and the whole tree burns at the first slash. It breaks if honest veterans sell vouches cheaply.
